column.annotate.text: Should this column receive an ontology-grounded annotation? Answer No for record identifiers, internal codes, timestamps and bookkeeping fields.

column.aspect.text: Which aspect of the dataset does this column describe?
options: taxon: the organisms observed, sampled or identified
environment: the biome, habitat or environmental material at a site
method: the sampling protocol, device, assay or processing step
measurement: a measured quantity, quality or attribute of a thing
unit: the unit of measure of a measured quantity
data_type: the kind of record, identifier, dataset or information artifact
location: a named place, region, plot or geographic feature
other: none of the above or not an annotatable column

column.ontology.text: Which ontology should be searched for a term that annotates this column?
options: ENVO: environments, biomes, habitats and environmental materials
NCBITaxon: organisms and taxa at every rank
PATO: qualities and attributes of things (size, sex, age, colour)
UO: units of measurement (meter, degree Celsius, percent)
OBI: investigations, assays, protocols, devices and specimens
IAO: information artifacts, data items, identifiers and documents
PCO: populations, communities and their collective properties
BCO: biological collections, sampling and identification processes
GAZ: named geographic places and administrative regions
RO: relations between entities (part of, located in, participates in)
TAXRANK: taxonomic ranks (species, genus, family, order)
GENEPIO: sample collection, identification and metadata fields

column.ontology_fits.text: Does the ontology described in the state contain the right kind of term for annotating this column?

term.fits.text: Is the candidate ontology term a correct annotation for the described column, site or dataset: the right concept at an appropriate specificity, not merely related?

term.fits.chooser.text: Is the candidate ontology term the correct term for the value the user wants to annotate with: the right concept at an appropriate specificity, not merely related?

avu.value_kind.text: What should the AVU value be?

avu.keep.text: Given the annotations already selected for this dataset, does this annotation add correct, non-redundant information worth keeping?

dataset.ontology_applies.text: Does this ontology apply to the dataset as a whole: would at least one of its terms correctly describe what the dataset measures, observes, samples or records?

datacite.resource_type_fits.text: Is the DataCite ResourceTypeGeneral value the right general type for this resource?

datacite.contributor_type.text: Which DataCite ContributorType best describes this contributor's role?

datacite.contributor_type_fits.text: Is the DataCite ContributorType value the right role for this contributor?

datacite.relation_type.text: Which DataCite RelationType describes how this resource relates to the related identifier?

datacite.relation_type_fits.text: Is the DataCite RelationType value the right relation from this resource to the related identifier?

datacite.date_type.text: Which DataCite DateType describes this date?

datacite.date_type_fits.text: Is the DataCite DateType value the right type for this date?

datacite.description_type.text: Which DataCite DescriptionType describes this description text?
